title: Krishna Ki Love Story
desc: Krishna falls in love with Mahalakshmi whose brother is a henchman of a don. During a gang war, he entrusts the responsibility of children to Krishna and asks him to return them to their parents.

title: Middle Class Love
desc: A young college boy who is disappointed with his family's middle-class lifestyle decides to escape it by joining a popular college and having a wealthy girlfriend.

title: Radhe Shyam
desc: Despite being a doctor with no inclination towards superstitious beliefs, Prerana places her love and faith in Aditya, a palmist whose predictions turn out to be too spot-on to be disregarded.

title: Jhoom Naacho Gao Yaaron
desc: Ganesh, a handicapped dancer, got injured because of Anthony, his rival. Later, two dancers train under him to defeat him.

title: Big Dhamaka
desc: Two men look alike, with one of them being a successful businessman and the other trying to find work. However, despite their differences, they end up falling for the same woman.

title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.
